Multi-hit initial payload to one recipient is intercepted once in full, not per die/missile. Record the root-recipient key before effect suppression. At0 end the ward. A copy uses only its real independently permitted new payment, never the old original payment; an exact no-resource descendant cannot fund recovery. Recovery is after interception and prevention of this branch, not countering or healing, and cannot refund its payer. A blocked/dead/full recipient wastes entitlement; no queue. Self/allied casts are legal but at most half actual base returns globally, preventing mutual net profitable recycling through this spell alone.
completeProposedProcedure.NEW_priority: Accepted cast counters first; Mirrors return once under their exact source; this Shield then sees the remaining initial actual recipient. completeProposedProcedure.NEW_award: NEW explicit anti-repeat receipt limit, selected L04-B: one Leyline Flow receipt attempt per actual identity across all casters/classes/copies since that identity’s actual beneficial completed long rest.
